posterColumns.title: Why this chapter, and why now
paras: Religious liberty is not an abstraction in Liberty. It arrives in a school board meeting, a workplace policy, a conversation across the fence — and almost never with any warning.
This chapter is where a congregation gets ready together, **before** that moment comes, instead of each member working it out alone afterward.
The ask is simple: eight evenings on your calendar, and a seat in the room.

posterColumns.title: What you'll actually learn
paras: The Champions Academy trains ordinary Christians to speak clearly about religious liberty — distinguishing God's **left-hand kingdom** from His **right-hand kingdom**, engaging the culture with humility rather than heat.
Eight guided evenings on life, marriage, education, and the First Amendment. No prior study required.
